description: This Java class 'EntityKeyMapping' is part of the Thingsboard project, responsible for mapping entity keys to database query components, including generating SQL snippets for filtering, selection, and joins based on entity attributes and filters.

classes.name: EntityKeyMapping
classes.description: A class responsible for mapping entity keys to SQL query components, including generating selection strings, join clauses, and filter predicates based on entity attributes and filters.

methods.name: hasFilter
methods.description: Checks if there are any key filters applied.

methods.name: getValueAlias
methods.description: Returns the alias for the value column based on the entity key type.

methods.name: getTsAlias
methods.description: Returns the alias for the timestamp column.

methods.name: toSelection
methods.description: Generates the SQL selection string for this entity key mapping based on filter type and entity type.

methods.name: toQueries
methods.description: Creates a stream of SQL query snippets for the key filters.

methods.name: toLatestJoin
methods.description: Generates the SQL join clause for the latest value of the entity key.

methods.name: buildSelections
methods.description: Builds a combined selection string from multiple entity key mappings.

methods.name: buildLatestJoins
methods.description: Builds combined latest join clauses for multiple mappings.

methods.name: buildQuery
methods.description: Builds a combined filter query from multiple mappings.

methods.name: prepareKeyMapping
methods.description: Prepares a list of EntityKeyMapping objects based on entity data query and entity type.

methods.name: setEntityKeyColumn
methods.description: Sets the entity key column based on existing entity fields.

methods.name: prepareEntityCountKeyMapping
methods.description: Prepares key mappings specifically for entity count queries.

methods.name: buildAttributeSelection
methods.description: Builds selection string for attribute or time series data.

methods.name: buildTimeSeriesSelection
methods.description: Builds selection string for time series data.

methods.name: buildTimeSeriesOrAttrSelection
methods.description: Helper for building selection strings for time series or attribute data.

methods.name: getSortOrderStrAlias
methods.description: Returns the alias for sort order string.

methods.name: getSortOrderNumAlias
methods.description: Returns the alias for sort order numeric value.

methods.name: buildKeyQuery
methods.description: Builds SQL predicate for a key filter.

methods.name: buildPredicateQuery
methods.description: Builds SQL predicate based on filter predicate type.

methods.name: buildComplexPredicateQuery
methods.description: Builds SQL for complex filter predicates.

methods.name: buildSimplePredicateQuery
methods.description: Builds SQL for simple filter predicates.

methods.name: buildStringPredicateQuery
methods.description: Builds SQL for string filter predicates.

methods.name: buildNumericPredicateQuery
methods.description: Builds SQL for numeric filter predicates.

methods.name: buildBooleanPredicateQuery
methods.description: Builds SQL for boolean filter predicates.

methods.name: getNextParameterName
methods.description: Generates a unique parameter name for query parameters.
